card.name: Cycle or month after next/every
card.fires_on: The words cycle, cycles or month right after a timing word such as next, subsequent, previous, consecutive or every. Seen in chemotherapy dose-adjustment and liver-test monitoring instructions.

modes.label: Treatment cycles
modes.description: The word cycle(s) after next, subsequent, previous or consecutive in dose-change rules.
modes.example: platelet count is less than 50 × 10 9 /L during any cycle, reduce the TEMODAR dose for the next<< cycle>> by 50 mg/m 2

modes.label: Monitoring by month
modes.description: The word month after every in schedules for liver tests.
modes.example: tests (ALT, AST, alkaline phosphatase, bilirubin) in all patients prior to initiating ALYFTREK, every<< month>> for first 6 months, every
